preconditions.description: The number of students n must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= fi <= n and fi != i for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each student's best friend index fi must be a valid student index and cannot be the student themselves.

preconditions.expression: all(si in {1, 2} for si in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each student's sex si must be either 1 (boy) or 2 (girl).

postconditions.description: The number of pairs t must equal the number of pairs formed.

postconditions.expression: e == sum((pairs[i][0] % 2 != pairs[i][1] % 2) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The number of boy-girl pairs e must be correctly counted among the formed pairs.

postconditions.expression: all(i in range(1, n+1) and j in range(1, n+1) for i, j in pairs)
postconditions.description: Each pair must consist of valid student indices within the range.
